verses.1: Brothers, even if a person falls into such a state through some kind of mistake, you who are spiritual beings should help to correct that situation within the spirit’s power. The goal is to prevent yourself from being affected by it as well.
verses.2: You balance each other’s burdens, and in doing so, you fulfill the law of Christ.
verses.3: For if anyone thinks that it is nothing at all, then he should repent in himself.
verses.4: And each person should try to test their own abilities. Only then will they be able to gain honor for themselves alone, and not for others.
verses.5: Each person will bear his own share of the burden.
verses.6: And the listener should share the message with everyone else, in all good ways.
verses.7: Do not be deceived; God does not deceive anyone. For if a person does something wrong, then He will surely punish him for it.
verses.8: For those who pour oil onto the body, they receive corruption from the body itself; but those who pour oil onto the spirit, they receive eternal life from the spirit.
verses.9: And when we do what is right, we must not be lazy; for at a specific time, we should refrain from doing anything else.
verses.10: Therefore, when the time comes, we will do what is right for everyone, especially those who belong to the community of believers.
verses.11: I have written these words in your own handwriting.
verses.12: Those who wish to appear good in the eyes of others, must force you to be beautiful. Only then will they not be condemned by Christ’s cross.
verses.13: For those who are corrupt, they will not even obey the law. Instead, they want you to be corrupt too, so that they can boast in your “corrupt flesh”.
verses.14: But it was not possible for me to boast, unless I were among the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. For through Him alone is the world crucified, and I too am crucified in the world.
verses.15: Neither circumcision nor anal mutilation is anything special; it’s just a new form of construction.
verses.16: And those who comply with this rule, peace and mercy shall be upon them. And also upon Israel, the people of God.
verses.17: I will not give you any more details about the rest. For I truly believe that Jesus’ spirit resides within my body.
verses.18: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, along with the Holy Spirit, brothers and sisters. Amen.
